The authors' code.R re-run on the package data (did 2.5.1, att_gt dr, notyettreated, varying base, weights num_individs_2015, cluster county, bstrap = FALSE; aggte simple, min_e = -8, max_e = 16) gives 0.007067067123 (analytic SE 0.0016778), stored in authors_rerun_coef; did 2.1.2 (the authors' pin, R 4.3.2) gives the same value to 7 significant digits. notes: PRINTED-APPENDIX SPECIFICATION (Nov 4, 2026): outside the main-text sample (PROTOCOL 5b ruling (r)); for the appendix-inclusive sensitivity analysis. Retail-to-Online Access design (gvar online_treat_time), sample of Appendix Table C.6 excluding the six iGaming states (Pennsylvania, West Virginia, New Jersey, Michigan, Delaware, Connecticut): code.R line 975, generate_results('online_treat_time', general_reg_data[rto_exclude_igaming == T]). Every flagged row lies inside rto_main_subset (0 rows outside; all rto_main_subset rows of the kept counties are flagged), so only the state sample changes. The online cohorts of quarters 11, 12, 14, 21 and 24 leave with the iGaming states. Sample: 1,339 counties, quarters 10-30, 16,505 rows (unbalanced: 1258 counties enter after quarter 10); 8 adoption cohorts (quarters 15,16,18,23,25,27,28,29); 495 never-online counties (37.5% of rows); no always-treated counties. The longest post period is 15 quarters, so drop_e_above = 16 removes no row and the authors' max_e = 16 aggregate equals the all-post aggregate. Authors report Callaway-Sant'Anna with the main-text settings (code.R generate_results(), lines 277-364: did::att_gt, control_group = 'notyettreated', est_method = 'dr', base_period = 'varying', allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, xformla = ~1, weightsname = 'num_individs_2015', clustervars = county, bstrap = TRUE without a seed; aggte(type = 'simple' or 'dynamic', min_e = -8, max_e = 16)). No TWFE regression exists in the package; the TWFE counterpart is D = 1[gvar > 0 & time >= gvar] with county FE + quarter FE, weights num_individs_2015, clustered by county. Treatment never switches off (defined from a unit-constant timing variable). Outcome levels were additively transformed by the authors to hide actual levels (README); county IDs anonymized; underlying UC Consumer Credit Panel is restricted. Project member Davide Proserpio is a coauthor (PROTOCOL Section 6). CAVEAT: the sample is an unbalanced panel with counties entering at their state's retail launch; did with allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE uses repeated-cross-section 2x2 cells whose control composition changes between g-1 and t, which drives the authors' and the pipeline's CSA estimates (see the replication log, 'composition-driven' section). TWFE and BJS are unaffected. y_sd_* are computed on the non-missing rows of the sample before drop_e_above, as in the main-text template.
csa_weights_note: Nov 2: the published CSA comes from R did (or staggered, whose estimates did reproduces), which weights cells by fixed cohort shares; Hull's DiD-averaging weights cells by treated-observation counts. 'did' reproduces the published number (main analysis, option B); the strict-Hull run (CSA_STRICT_HULL=1, option A) ignores this field.
